events.body:
## Context

README tells you to enable GitHub Pages on a `copilot/...` branch; the site is deployed with `scripts/deploy.sh blt-gsoc`. The tree lists files that don't exist (`.nojekyll`, `images/gsoc.png`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `SUMMARY.md`), "History" appears twice, and the page list leaves out `gsoc2026.html`, `mentor-guide.html`, `progress-tracker.html`, `contributors/` and `certificates/`.

## What to do

1. Replace the Pages section with `scripts/deploy.sh blt-gsoc`.
2. Fix the tree and page list; remove the duplicate heading; fix "GitHub Pages" wording in README and `pr-report.html`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every path in the README exists
- [ ] No GitHub Pages instructions

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-gsoc && ./run.sh
```

---
